description:
Add oscillator phase noise and carrier frequency offset as channel impairments so receiver robustness and high-order QAM degradation can be studied.

## Background

The `gf2-sim` channel stages model additive noise and memoryless fading. Phase noise (for example a Wiener process) and frequency offset are stateful across symbols within a frame, which interacts with the per-frame RNG seek contract and with the demapper's assumption of a known channel phase.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A phase-noise stage with a configurable model (at minimum a Wiener phase process parameterised by linewidth or variance per symbol) exists.
- [hard] REQ-02: A carrier-frequency-offset stage with a configurable normalised offset exists.
- [hard] REQ-03: Both stages are deterministic per frame at a fixed seed and byte-identical across worker counts.
- [hard] REQ-04: A statistical test confirms the generated phase process matches the configured model within a stated tolerance.

## Notes

Compensation (phase tracking, CFO estimation) is receiver-side work and may be tracked separately.
title: Phase noise and carrier frequency offset impairments
